_slow_mover_note: Reference values, and three tests in test_reads.py assert the alerts they produce. With no order history yet, min_stock 12 reports every listing in this store as a slow mover on day one. Raising it to about 60 while pre-launch silences that, at the cost of those three reference tests; lower it back toward 12 once a few weeks of orders exist. Change it deliberately, not by accident.
